At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a naval '''battle''' occurred between the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and a [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] commanded by Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]]. The Zygerrians were soundly defeated, losing their [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Hordem Molec/Legends|Hordem Molec]], the elder son of the Zygerrian [[King/Legends|King]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]]. The King blamed his second son, [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]], who had survived the battle, for provoking the conflict with the Imperials. Distraught at the loss of Hordem, the King [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Sono to the Zygerrian outpost on the planet [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]].<ref name="FLT" />
